causal_findings.claim: The initial tool-continuation failure reproduces in a fresh worker without preceding arithmetic/Python/JSON probes.
Clearing unusable session-cache ownership alone did not resolve the live continuation OOM.
Setting shrink ON alone did not resolve the failure; worker confirmed enabled but produced zero shrink-entry logs.
causal_findings.epistemic_status: observed behavior; view-capacity mechanism subsequently reproduced in bounded fixtures

causal_findings.claim: Logical trimming plus per-model shrink emitted 16 tool-prefix shrink entries at offset263, from1024 to2MiB per cache, but continuation still OOMed. These logs did not establish actual backing allocation release.

Eager evaluation and synchronization before publishing compact buffers removed cache-owned lazy graph/command-buffer retention in bounded real-MLX fixtures; later full five-case and fresh two-request tool smokes passed.
causal_findings.epistemic_status: mechanism demonstrated by regression fixtures; live observed recovery, not universal memory certification

causal_findings.claim: Persistent generator-owned KV leakage across fully completed cached requests was considered but not demonstrated; CPU weak-reference audit showed EOS aliases can survive during retirement and die after outer-stream exhaustion. No generator-close repair was made.
causal_findings.epistemic_status: bounded read-only ownership audit; not a live failure attribution
causal_findings.evidence: Conversation diagnostic only; no standalone saved trace was located, so no invented artifact/hash is supplied.

limitations: Failed SSE responses are runtime/instrument failures, not wrong-answer quality grades.
Tool-call handoff uses finish_reason=tool_calls and is recorded separately from stop convergence; a successful handoff can have converged=false.
The three-pass item summaries in failed five-case runs omit the completed first tool request; request inventory explicitly includes it.
No short-generation peak-memory value is used as capacity evidence.
No semantic cause is inferred from the generic harness invalid-SSE error alone; the preserved SSE contains the Metal OOM code.
Source-file hashes are reconstructed from launch-recorded commits; historical launch environment snapshots omit shrink override environment variables, so unobserved effective flags remain null.
Six failed runs, three passing controls/smokes inventoried; final capacity and quality results are outside this file.
